# Conformance mods `stack_dep`, `stack_cycle`, `eaw_only` (mcx3 t07)

A synthetic FoC folder (`corruption/Data`), an EaW install next to it (`GameData`, an empty `sweaw.exe` so the VFS
detects it) and the mods below under `corruption/Mods`, with no game data. Checked by
`alamo_game_conformance_stacks_tests` (`engine/apps/game/tests/test_conformance_stacks.cpp`) against
`docs/MOD_COMPAT_DESIGN.md` 5.2 / 5.4 and `docs/MODS.md` 3.1. The `meg_unsorted` case of the same task is generated by
`alamo_vfs_registry_tests` ("meg mount (conformance meg_unsorted)": a MEG whose record table is crafted, mcx3 t04).

| Mod | Mechanism |
|---|---|
| `StackParent` | A total conversion (own `GameObjectFiles.xml` and `FactionFiles.xml`), tagged `FOC`, version 2.0 |
| `StackSub` | Declares `Mods\StackParent` in `modinfo.json` (with a `//` comment and trailing commas): resolves to Sub, Parent |
| `StackHinted` | No `modinfo.json`; its object list names `ParentObjects.xml` and `ParentShips.xml`, which only `StackParent` has: the submod hint adds it |
| `StackTop` | The exit test's shape (AOW compatibility patch -> Thrawn's Legacy HD -> Thrawn's Revenge), nothing declared: its list names `StackHinted`'s three files and `StackParent`'s two; from the `StackTop` folder alone the hint adds `StackHinted`, then `StackParent` |
| `OtherTc` | A second total conversion: stacked with `StackParent`, a conflict warning |
| `CycleA`, `CycleB` | Declare each other: a cycle error naming both |
| `EawOnly` | Tagged `EAW` (and not `FOC`): refused before loading, grade G0 (D1) |
| `EawGuess` | No tags; its object list names none of the files FoC's list has and EaW's lacks (`FocObjects.xml`): loads, with the base-EaW heuristic's warning |

ums1 t06 adds a Steam library, `steamlib` (the launch-surface table sets `ALAMO_STEAM_ROOT` to it): workshop item
`900000201` has variant files only, `subA` on `Mods\StackParent` and `subB` on `Mods\OtherTc` (2083545253's shape), so
the table also has `STEAMMOD=` lists and two rows sharing one folder. The other tests here give no Steam library.

The base FoC object list names `BaseObjects.xml` and `FocObjects.xml`; the EaW one (`GameData/Data/XML`) only
`BaseObjects.xml`. Files are small and edited by hand.
